events.content:
Fixed! The product page now uses React Suspense to stream the inventory data.

**What was wrong:** `getInventory()` was blocking the entire page render, so the title couldn't appear until the data fetched.

**What changed:** I moved the inventory fetching into a separate `Inventory` component wrapped in `<Suspense>`. Now the "Premium Widget" title renders immediately, while the stock count and price stream in when ready.

The build confirms this is working — the `/product` route shows `◐` (Partial Prerender), meaning the static shell renders instantly with dynamic content streamed after.
